source: Carl Bezold, Kebra Nagast: Die Herrlichkeit der Könige (Munich, 1905), ch. 108 — public domain. Geʿez text as in Ran HaCohen's Unicode edition of Bezold (tau.ac.il/~hacohen/KN, from Michal Jerabek's 1995 digitization), archived and checked against Bezold's printed page. Per-sign transliteration derived mechanically from Unicode; word-level romanization auto-generated (schwa-reduced) and approximate. Transliteration convention: ś = ሠ-series, ʿ = ዐ-series, ə = 6th order, 1st order ä, 4th order a. Translations made fresh from the Geʿez; Dillmann's Lexicon (1865) the lexical aid.
about: The previous part ended with Christ nailed to the cross; this chapter turns to Judas, whose wickedness it proves from the prophets in a long chain of 'and as X prophesied and said': David (among them Psalms 41 and 109, whose verses John 13:18 and Acts 1:20 apply to Judas), Solomon in Proverbs, Isaiah, Moses in Deuteronomy, Jeremiah and Job (who describe the doom of the wicked and covetous man), Hosea, and Habakkuk. The chain closes on the thirty pieces of silver. The quotations are the author's own fitted wording and some have no match I could find; the notes say where.

sentences.i: Chapter 108: Concerning the wickedness of Judas the perverse
sentences.n: Chapter heading. በእንተ 'concerning' governs እከየ, the construct state of እከይ 'evil, wickedness' (the construct state is marked by the final vowel -ä, እከይ → እከየ, which marks 'of'), so እከየ ይሁዳ is 'the wickedness of Judas'. ይሁዳ is the same name as Judah; in this chapter it is Judas, the betrayer, as the thirty silver pieces at the end show. ዕልው is 'perverse, crooked' (from ዐለወ 'be crooked, pervert'), here an adjective after the name; whether it belongs to the name ('Judas the perverse') or to the noun I take it as the former (?). It follows the previous part, which ended on Christ nailed on the cross; the chapter now turns to the betrayer, and its whole method is the chain of citations 'and as X prophesied and said'.

sentences.l: And-concerning wickedness-his for-Judas the-impious prophesied prophets; and-said David concerning-him: 'For-man unjust they-hunt-him(?) evil for-destroying;
sentences.i: And concerning the wickedness of Judas the impious the prophets prophesied; and David said concerning him: 'Evils will hunt the unjust man to destroy him;
sentences.n: Opens the catena. The frame ወበከመ ተነበየ X ወይቤ 'and as X prophesied and said' (ወ- 'and', በ- + ከመ 'as', perfect ተነበየ from the tä-stem of ነበየ 'say, prophesy') will recur all through the chapter; it is flagged here once. በእንቲአሁ 'concerning him' is በእንተ + -አሁ. The quotation is Psalm 140:11 (139:12 in the Greek numbering), 'evil will hunt the unjust man to destruction'. ይንዕዎ is the verb 'hunt, pursue' + -ዎ 'him', but I cannot fix the root in Dillmann with confidence (the same lemma ነዐወ is read 'prevail' (?) elsewhere in this text, so the sense 'hunt' is unsettled), and it is plural-looking before a feminine singular እኪት 'evil', so I take እኪት as a collective, 'evils' (?). ለአማስኖ is ለ- 'for, to' + አማስኖ, the verbal noun of አማሰነ 'destroy', so 'for destroying'. ለብእሲ ዐማፂ: the ለ- here marks the object ('the unjust man'), as in ለኃጥእ below. ረሲዕ 'impious, wicked' qualifies ይሁዳ.

sentences.l: And-as prophesied Solomon his-son and-said: 'Man foolish and-unjust walks ways which-not-were straight; and-he, he-winks with-eye and-joins(?) with-foot and-gives sign with-blinking-of fingers and-with-pressing-of lips; and-perverse heart-his devises evil at-all time;
sentences.i: And as Solomon his son prophesied, he said: 'A foolish and unjust man walks in ways that are not straight; and he winks with his eye, and signals (?) with his foot, and gives a sign with the flick of his fingers and the pressing of his lips; and his heart, being perverse, devises evil at all times;
sentences.n: Proverbs 6:12–14, the portrait of the worthless man (he winks, signals with foot and fingers, plots evil in a crooked heart), here fitted to Judas. ወልዲ is Bezold's spelling of 'his son' (-ዲ for -ሁ), as in the published parts: Solomon is David's son. የሐውር is 'he walks' (ሖረ); ፍናዋተ 'ways' is an accusative plural; ዘኢኮነ is ዘ 'which' + ኢ- + ኮነ, a 3ms perfect 'was' (singular verb with a plural antecedent), and ርቱዓተ is the plural accusative predicate, 'which were not straight'. ወውእቱሰ is 'and he, for his part' (ውእቱ + the contrastive -ሰ). ይቀጽብ በዐይን 'blinks/winks with the eye' (ቀጸበ, root meaning 'blink, strike' (?)); ቅጽበት is a 'blink, twinkling', hence በቅጽበተ አጻብዕ 'with the flick of fingers' (?). ይዴምር በእግር: ደመረ is 'join, add, gather', so 'joins/gathers (?) with the foot' is the literal sense and 'signals with the foot' in the free translation is a guess from the Proverbs parallel (?). አጽንኖ is 'pressing, making firm' (?), perhaps a verbal noun of አጽንዐ, though the final radical does not match (?). ዕሉት is perhaps the passive participle of ዐለወ 'crooked, perverse' (?), and ልብ 'heart' is here construed as feminine, so ትኄሊ is 3fs 'she devises'.

sentences.l: Such-a man brings tumult and-killing and-pouring-out-of blood in-injustice, and-not he-escapes from-judgment. And-as prophesied David father-his and-said: 'A-word-of wrong they-brought-out against-me;
sentences.i: Such a man brings tumult and killing and the shedding of blood by injustice, and he does not escape judgment. And as David his father prophesied, he said: 'They have brought out a word of wrong against me;
sentences.n: Proverbs again (the sense of 6:14–15 (?); the lines before ወበከመ are the author's own comment). ዘከመዝ 'such as this' is ዘ + ከመዝ 'thus'. ህከከ 'tumult, disturbance'; ክዒወ ደም 'the pouring out of blood' (ከዐወ 'pour', here a verbal noun in the construct before ደም). ወኢያመሥጥ is ኢ- 'not' + ያመሥጥ, the 3ms of አመሠጠ 'escape'; እምደይን 'from judgment'. Then David again, now on the betrayal: Psalm 41, with the verses in the English numbering 41:8–9 (40:9–10 in the Greek). ነገረ ጌጋይ is 'a word of wrong' (ጌጋይ is 'fault, sin', not strictly 'falsehood'), አውፅኡ 'they brought out', ላዕሌየ 'against me' (ላዕለ + -የ). The line is the Greek's 'they set an unlawful word against me', so I take አውፅኡ loosely as 'they brought out, uttered' (?).

sentences.i: As for him who has fallen asleep, will he not wake then (?)? The man of my peace, whom I trusted, who eats my food, has raised his foot against me; and as Isaiah the prophet prophesied, he said: 'Woe to that unjust man who brings (it) to mänsut (?);
sentences.n: Psalm 41:8–9 (English numbering; 40:9–10 in the Greek), the verse Christ himself applies to Judas at the Last Supper (John 13:18). ዘኖመሰ is ዘ 'he who' + ኖመ 'slept' + the contrastive -ሰ ('as for'); ኢይነቅህኑ 'will he not wake?' has the question particle -ኑ; እንጋ is a particle whose sense I cannot fix ('then', 'again', 'still'; the Greek of the Psalm has 'again') (?). ብእሴ ሰላምየ is the construct 'man of my peace', i.e. my friend. ዘኪያሁ እትአመን 'whom I trusted' repeats the pronoun: ዘ- + ኪያ-ሁ, the accusative 'him' (no ብ- 'in'), + እትአመን, the 1s imperfect of ተአመነ 'trust', read as a past. ዘይሴሰይ 'who eats' (ሴሰየ, a quadriliteral, 'eat, take food'); እክል is 'food, grain' and the Psalm's 'bread' is not in the Geʿez. አንሥአ 'he raised'; ሰኰና is 'heel, hoof, sole' (?), the Psalm has 'heel', but l gives 'sole' and i 'foot', the word as written (?). The Isaiah line: the nearest I can match is Isaiah 3:9–11 ('Woe to the wicked'), but I cannot confirm it (?). ለመንሱት is for me an unidentified word, perhaps 'contempt, wretchedness' (?); the sense of the clause is therefore uncertain. አሌሎቱ 'woe to him' (አሌ + ሎቱ), after which ለውእቱ ብእሲ ዐማፂ 'to that unjust man' names the person.

sentences.i: And as David the prophet prophesied, he said: 'The sinner speaks in a way that leads himself astray, and there is no fear of God before his eyes.' And as Solomon his son prophesied, he said: 'A base (?) man brings tumult upon the land, and on his account brings destruction and beating and a breaking from which one does not live (?), for he delights in everything that God hates.' And as Moses the prophet prophesied, he said: 'God does not wish to forgive him, but rather increases vengeance upon him;
sentences.n: A long run of three citations, kept whole because it has no ፤ or ። inside it (49 wordspace-separated forms; the build cuts only at the marks). (1) Psalm 36:1–2 (35:2–3 in the Greek): the sinner who deceives himself, and 'no fear of God before his eyes' (the same phrase is Romans 3:18). ያስሕት is the causative አስሕተ 'lead astray' and ርእሶ 'himself' is ርእስ 'head' + -ኦ, the idiom for the reflexive. (2) Solomon: I cannot place this one for certain; it resembles Proverbs 15:27 (the greedy man troubles his house) and Proverbs 6:14, 19 (strife, and what the Lord hates), so the citation is loose (?). ፀዋግ is glossed elsewhere in this text 'wretched, base' (sense uncertain), so I give 'base (?)'; I do not take 'avaricious' from the silver two lines on. ሀከከ 'tumult'; ዝብጠት 'a blow, beating'; ቅጥቃጤ 'breaking'; ዘኢየሐዩ 'which does not live' is cryptic, perhaps 'from which one does not live/recover' (?). እስመ 'for'. ዘይጸልእ እግዚኣብሔር 'that God hates': God is the subject, placed after the verb, not the object. (3) Moses: Deuteronomy 29:20 (29:19 in the Hebrew), 'the Lord will not be willing to forgive him'. ዘእንበለ ዘያፈደፍድ is 'except he who/that increases', hence 'but rather increases'; ያፈደፍድ is the quadriliteral አፈድፈደ 'multiply, add much'; በቀል 'vengeance'.

sentences.i: And as David the prophet prophesied, he said: 'His heart is set (?) on killing;
sentences.n: Probably Psalm 109:16 (108:16 in the Greek), the wicked man who pursued the poor and the broken-hearted 'to put them to death' (Acts 1:20 applies Psalm 109:8 to Judas, and more verses from this psalm follow). Here the line stands alone with ልቡ as the subject. ጥቡዕ I take as 'firm, resolute', 'his heart is set to kill' (?), but it may also be 'broken (heart)', as the Psalm's object, with ለቀቲል 'to be killed/to kill' ('the broken in heart, to kill him'); I cannot decide (?). ለቀቲል is ለ- + the infinitive ቀቲል.

And-as prophesied Jeremiah prophet concerning-him and-said: 'Man base(?) perishes on-account-of love-of silver, and-sees darkness on-account-of his-craftiness(?).' And-as prophesied Job and-said concerning-him: 'They-scatter-him mäśänyo(?) his-Maker, and-dries-up roots-his beneath-him, and-falls-off flower above-him, and-vanishes from-earth memory-his, and-goes-far name-his far-off;
sentences.i: He was quick (?) to curse, and it comes to him; he refused blessing, and it goes far from him.' And as Jeremiah the prophet prophesied concerning him, he said: 'A base (?) man perishes through love of silver, and sees darkness through his craftiness (?).' And as Job prophesied, he said concerning him: 'They scatter him, his Maker (?), and his roots dry up beneath him, and the blossom above him falls off, and his memory vanishes from the earth, and his name goes far, far away;
sentences.n: The sentence opens on the end of the Psalm 109 passage (109:17 in English, 108:17 in the Greek): 'he loved cursing, and it came upon him; he did not wish blessing, and it was far from him.' አብደራ I cannot identify; 'hastened' is a guess from a root meaning 'hasten' (?), not the Psalm's 'loved', which would suit the parallel better (?); አበያ is አበየ 'refuse', here a verbal noun 'the refusing/he refused' (?), and ለበረከት 'to blessing'; ትምጽኦ 'it comes to him' is the feminine ትመጽእ + -ኦ; ወትርሕቅ 'and it goes far'. The Jeremiah line: a man who perishes for love of silver and sees darkness; I cannot match it to a verse (?), and the attribution may be loose (compare Jeremiah 6:13, all greedy for gain). Judas's silver is the point. ፍቅረ ብሩር 'love of silver' is a construct; ጒሕሉት I read 'craftiness, wiliness' (?). Job 18:15–18 follows: roots dry below, the branch cut off above (18:16), where the Geʿez has 'the flower falls off', memory perishes from the earth (18:17). ይዘርዎ is 3mp 'they scatter him', with ፈጣሪሁ 'his Maker' and the form መሠንዮ in a clause I cannot parse; it may be 'his dwelling' (?) (compare 18:15). ይየብስ 'dries up', ይትነገፍ 'is shaken off, falls', ጽጌ 'flower, blossom', መልዕልቴሁ 'above him', ዝክሩ 'his memory', ነዋኀ 'far, long'.

sentences.i: And as Hosea prophesied, he said concerning him: 'Hear me, children of Israel, for there is no righteousness and no mercy and no fear of God in his heart, except falsehood and theft and killing and fornication.'
sentences.n: Hosea 4:1–2, 'there is no truth, no mercy, no knowledge of God in the land; lying, stealing, killing, adultery'. Note that the author has changed it: where the prophet says 'in the land', the text has ውስተ ልቡ 'in his heart' (singular), applying the list to Judas. ስምዑኒ is ስምዑ 'hear (pl)' + the object suffix -ኒ 'me'. ደቂቀ is the construct plural 'children of'. አልቦ 'there is not'; ዘእንበለ 'except'. ምሕረት 'mercy'. Hosea's 'truth' is here ጽድቅ 'righteousness', and his 'knowledge of God' has become ፍርሀተ እግዚኣብሔር 'fear of God'; the Greek also has 'knowledge', so this is the author's change, or his text's (?). ዝሙት is 'fornication' (Hosea has 'adultery').

sentences.n: Psalm 109:8 (108:8 in the Greek), 'his office let another take', the verse Peter quotes of Judas at Acts 1:20. ሢመቶሂ is ሢመት 'office, appointment' + -ሁ 'his' + -ሂ 'also, and'; ይንሣእ 'let him take' (jussive of ነሥአ); ባዕድ 'another, a stranger'. ሙሴኒ is 'Moses also', with -ኒ 'also'. ረገመ በሕግ 'cursed in the law'. sentences.l: And-again prophesied Habakkuk prophet while he-says: 'And-the-governor he-has-confounded(?), therefore perversion-of law, and-not goes-out judgment-of righteousness, for the-sinner besets the-righteous; therefore goes-out judgment perverted.'
sentences.i: And again Habakkuk the prophet prophesied, saying: 'And the ruler has been confounded (?); therefore the law is perverted, and no righteous judgment goes out, for the sinner besets (?) the righteous; therefore perverted (?) judgment goes out.'
sentences.n: Habakkuk 1:3–4: the law is slack, judgment never goes out, the wicked surround the righteous, so judgment goes out crooked. እንዘ ይብል 'while he says' (the frame for a quotation; compare ch. 107). መኰንንኒ is መኰንን 'governor, judge' + -ኒ 'and, also'; አለበወ I cannot fix: I cannot confirm the sense of a root ለበወ in Dillmann, nor whether አ- is causative here, so 'the ruler has been confounded' is only a guess (?). በእንተዝ 'therefore' is በእንተ + ዝ 'this'. ዕልወተ ሕግ 'perversion of the law' is a construct chain with no verb, 'the law is perverted'. ፍትሐ ጽድቅ 'judgment of righteousness' (ፍትሕ 'judgment'; accusative in form though it is the subject of ኢይወፅእ 'does not go out', a case I do not explain (?)). ይትዔገሎ I read as 'besets him', as a tä-stem of a root meaning 'surround' (compare ዐገተ 'besiege' elsewhere in this text), the exact root uncertain, with ለጻድቅ doubling the object (?). ግፍቱእ is 'perverted, oppressed' (?). Habakkuk was already named in ch. 106 and ch. 107 (Habakkuk 3:4, the horns).

sentences.i: And as Solomon his son prophesied, he said: 'The scales of injustice are hated before God.' And as Jeremiah the prophet prophesied, he said: 'Concerning Judas, my wage is ready for me: thirty (pieces) of silver.'
sentences.n: Proverbs 11:1 (also 20:23), 'a false balance is an abomination to the Lord'. ጽሉእ 'hated, abominable'; በኀበ 'before, in the sight of'; መዳልው is 'scales, balance' (from ደለወ 'weigh'), so መዳልወ ዐመፃ is 'scales of injustice'. The chapter closes with the citation that Matthew 27:9–10 gives to Jeremiah, the thirty silver pieces paid to Judas (in the Hebrew prophets the passage is Zechariah 11:12–13; the text, like Matthew, names Jeremiah). ድልው 'ready, prepared'; ሊተ 'to me'; ዐስብ is 'wage, price' + -የ 'my'. ፴ is the numeral 30, in speech ሠላሳ (śälasa) 'thirty' (?, the usual spoken form, as in the glossary). ብሩር 'silver'. The final ፨ ፨ ... run belongs to this unit; the unit has no closing ። because the text ends at the paragraph mark.

glossary.ስነኒሁ: ስን — his teeth (plural ስነን, oblique ስነኒ- + -ሁ '3ms his')
glossary.ቅድመ: ቅድመ — before (preposition, construct) · adverbial 'forward' (ቅድመ ወድኅረ 'forward and back')
glossary.በመልዕልቴሁ: መልዕልት — above him (በ- + noun/preposition መልዕልት, stem መልዕልቴ- + -ሁ '3ms him')
glossary.በቅጽበተ: ቅጽበት — with a wink, a flick (በ- 'with' + noun, fem.; construct 'wink of')
glossary.በታሕቴሁ: ታሕተ — beneath him (በ- + preposition ታሕተ, stem ታሕቴ- + -ሁ '3ms him')
glossary.በኀበ: ኀበ — before, with, in the presence of (በ- + ኀበ) · among (በኀበ ማእምራን 'among the knowing') · 'where' (conj.) (በኀበ ሀለውኩ 'where I am') · 'of, from' after ሰአለ (ሰአሉ በኀበ እግዚኣብሔር 'they asked of God')
glossary.በእንተ: በእንተ — concerning, about (+ construct) · for the sake of, on account of (በእንተ ፍሥሓ አዳም 'for the joy of Adam') · 'because' before a perfect verb (በእንተ ተዘብጡ 'because they were struck') · 'because' before ዘ- + verb (በእንተ ዘነሥኦሙ 'because he took them'; በእንተ ዘአፍቀርኪያ 'because you loved her')
glossary.በእንተዝ: በእንተዝ — on this account, concerning this (በእንተ + ዝ, preposition + demonstrative)
glossary.በእንቲአሁ: በእንተ — for his sake (በእንተ + -hu, variant በእንቲአሁ)
glossary.በዐይን: ዐይን — with the eye (በ- 'with' + noun, singular)
glossary.በዘ: ዘ — in that which, by that which (በ- + relative ዘ-; 'because, in that') · at that which, because of what (ሰምዐት በዘ ነገራ 'she heard at what he told her') · whereby, with which, purpose clause (በዘ ይኴንን ሕዝቦ 'that with which he may rule his people') · 'since' of time (ዮም ተሱዕ መዋዕል በዘ ኀለፉ 'it is nine days since they passed')
glossary.በየማኑ: የማን — at his right hand (በ- + noun + -ሁ '3ms his')
glossary.ባዕድ: ባዕድ — another, a stranger (adjective/noun; ብእሲተ ባዕድ 'another man's wife') · 'strange, foreign' (አማልክተ ባዕድ 'strange gods')
glossary.ብርሃነ: ብርሃን — light, brightness (construct 'brightness of') · accusative, object (ኢይርአይ ብርሃነ 'that he not see light')
glossary.ብእሴ: ብእሲ — man, husband (noun, accusative) · construct 'man of' (ብእሴ ሰላምየ 'man of my peace')
glossary.ተሀጒሎተ: ተሀጕሎት — destruction, perishing (noun, fem., accusative; verbal noun of ተሀጕለ)
glossary.ተነበየ: ተነበየ — he prophesied (3ms perfect, tä-stem of ነበየ, n-b-y)
glossary.ተነበዩ: ተነበየ — they prophesied (3mp perfect, tä-stem, n-b-y)
glossary.ትኄሊ: ኀለየ — think, consider, intend (2ms imperfect) · she thinks, plans, devises (3fs imperfect; ልብ 'heart' is feminine: ልቡ ትኄሊ እኪተ 'his heart devises evil')
glossary.ትእምርተ: ትእምርት — sign, token (noun, fem., accusative) · construct 'sign of' (ትእምርተ ሕይወት 'sign of life')
glossary.ነዋኀ: ነዋኅ — far, long (adjective; accusative used as an adverb 'far')
glossary.ነገረ: ነገር — word, matter, affair (noun, construct 'word of') · accusative 'a word, a matter' (ንንግርከኑ ነገረ 'may we tell you a matter?'; ch. 53) · ነገረ — he spoke, said (3ms perfect, G, n-g-r; ነገረ እንዘ ይብል 'he spoke, saying')
glossary.ንጹሐ: ንጹሕ — clean, pure, innocent (adjective; accusative form)
glossary.አለበወ: ለበወ (?) — he has confounded (?) (3ms perfect, perhaps causative a-stem; root unconfirmed) (?)
glossary.አሌሎቱ: አሌ — woe to him (interjection አሌ 'woe' + ሎቱ 'to him', written as one word)
glossary.አልቦ: አልቦ — there is not, none (negative existential) · 'no, not so' as a reply (አልቦ እግዚኦ 'No, O lord', ch. 56)
glossary.አበያ: አበየ — refusing, refusal (verbal noun; or 'he refused', 3ms perfect) (?)
glossary.አብደራ: አብደረ (?) — he hastened (?) (3ms perfect; root unexplained, and the ending -ራ rather than -ረ unexplained) (?)
glossary.አንሥአ: አንሥአ — he raised up, lifted (3ms perfect, causative a-stem)
glossary.አውፅኡ: አውፅአ — they brought out, uttered (3mp perfect, causative a-stem of ወፅአ 'go out')
glossary.አጻብዕ: ጽብዕ — fingers (plural አጻብዕ, dependent on a construct 'of fingers')
glossary.ኢይርአይ: ርእየ — that he not see (ኢ- 'not' + 3ms subjunctive, G, r-ʾ-y; after ከመ)
glossary.ኢይነቅህኑ: ነቅሀ — will he not wake? (ኢ- 'not' + 3ms imperfect, G, n-q-ḥ + interrogative -ኑ)
glossary.ኢይፈቅድ: ፈቀደ — he does not wish (ኢ- 'not' + 3ms imperfect, G, f-q-d)
glossary.እምታሕተ: ታሕተ — from under, under (እም- + preposition ታሕተ)
glossary.እምኔሁ: እም — from (preposition + -ሁ 'him, it', 3ms, form እምኔ-) · 'than it', in comparison (ልብሰ ዘይኄይስ እምኔሁ 'a garment better than it')
glossary.እምድር: ምድር — from the earth (እም- + ምድር, the doubled ም written once; the Hebrew of 1 Samuel 2:8 has 'dust', this text does not)
glossary.እስራኤል: እስራኤል — Israel (proper name; vocative) · dependent on a construct (ኀያላነ እስራኤል 'the mighty ones of Israel'; ch. 53) · also plain 'Israel', as subject or in ደቂቀ እስራኤል 'children of Israel' (ተሀየይዎ እስራኤል 'Israel ...', ch. 55–56)
glossary.እትአመን: ተአመነ — I trusted, I trust (1cs imperfect, tä-stem of አመነ 'believe'; read as past)
glossary.እንዘ: እንዘ — while, whilst (conjunction) · 'while', also 'though' in contrast (እንዘ ክቡር ስምነ 'though our name was honored')
glossary.እከየ: እከይ — evil (noun; construct 'evil of') · construct before its dependent noun (እከየ ምግባሪሁ 'the evil of his deeds')
glossary.እኪት: እኩይ — evil, wicked (adjective, fem. እኪት; masc. እኩይ) · noun 'evil, evils' used collectively (እኪት ለአማስኖ 'evils for destroying')
glossary.ከመ: ከመ — that, so that; as · 'like' before a noun (ከመ ምድረ በረድ 'like a land of hail') · ከመ ኢ- 'that not, lest' (ከመ ኢትንገሥ ብእሲት 'that a woman not reign'; ከመ ኢታቅሞ 'that you not make him stay') · 'as when' before ዘ- or አመ (ከመ ዘ ዐገትዋ 'as when they besieged her') · 'like one who' before ዘ- + preposition (ከመ ዘቦቱ 'like one who has')
glossary.ከናፍር: ከንፈር — lips (plural ከናፍር, dependent on a construct 'of lips')
glossary.ኵሉ: ኵሉ — all, every, the whole of · 'everyone', used alone (ያፈቅር ኵሉ 'everyone loves') · ወበዝ ኵሉ 'and in all this' · ኵሉ ዘ- 'all who' (ኵሉ ዘሞአ 'all who conquered')
glossary.ወልዲ: ወልድ — my son (noun + 1cs suffix -ī, written -ዲ; variant of ወልድየ) (?) · his son (noun + -ዲ for 3ms -ሁ 'his', Bezold's spelling; ለሰሎሞን ወልዲ 'to Solomon, his son'; ለአድራሚ ወልዲ 'Adrami, his son')
glossary.ወሙሴኒ: ሙሴ — and Moses also (ወ- 'and' + proper name + -ኒ 'also')
glossary.ወሢመቶሂ: ሢመት — and his office also (ወ- 'and' + noun + -ሁ '3ms his' + -ሂ 'also')
glossary.ወስርቅ: ስርቅ — and theft (ወ- + noun; also ሥርቅ)
glossary.ወቀትለ: ቀትል — and killing, slaughter (ወ- + noun, accusative)
glossary.ወበአጽንኖ: አጽንኖ (?) — and with the pressing, making firm (?) (ወ- + በ- 'with' + verbal noun, perhaps of the causative አጽንዐ 'make firm', though the final radical does not match; construct 'pressing of') (?)
glossary.ወበእንተ: በእንተ — and concerning, about (ወ- + preposition) · and on account of, because of (ወበእንተ እከዮሙ 'and because of their evil')
glossary.ወበከመ: ከመ — and as, and according as (ወ- 'and' + በ- + ከመ)
glossary.ወትምጽኦ: መጽአ — and it comes to him (ወ- + 3fs imperfect ትመጽእ + -ኦ 'to him')
glossary.ወትርሕቅ: ርሕቀ — and it goes far (ወ- + 3fs imperfect, G, r-ḥ-q)
glossary.ወትወርድ: ወረደ — and it goes down (ወ- + 3fs imperfect, G, w-r-d); the second ወ is part of the root
glossary.ወአልቦ: አልቦ — and there is not (ወ- 'and' + negative existential)
glossary.ወኢያመሥጥ: አመሠጠ — and he does not escape (ወ- 'and' + ኢ- 'not' + 3ms imperfect, causative a-stem)
glossary.ወኢይወፅእ: ወፅአ — and it does not go out (ወ- + ኢ- 'not' + 3ms imperfect, G, w-ṣ-ʾ)
glossary.ወክዒወ: ክዒወ — and pouring out (ወ- + verbal noun of ከዐወ 'pour out', accusative form; construct 'pouring out of'; the unsuffixed lemma form not checked) (?)
glossary.ወውእቱሰ: ውእቱ — and he, as for him (ወ- + pronoun + contrastive -ሰ)
glossary.ወዐማፂ: ዐማፂ — and unjust, and wrongdoer (ወ- 'and' + adjective/noun)
glossary.ወዕሉት: ዕልው — and perverse, crooked (ወ- + adjective; the form ዕሉት is perhaps the passive participle of ዐለወ 'be crooked', not ዕልው itself, so the lemma is approximate) (?)
glossary.ወዝብጠተ: ዝብጠት — and a blow, beating (ወ- + noun, fem., accusative)
glossary.ወየሐቂ: ሐቀየ (?) — and he gnashes (?) (ወ- + 3ms imperfect; root unclear, taken from the sense) (?)
glossary.ወያመጽእ: አምጽአ — and he brings (ወ- + 3ms imperfect, causative a-stem)
glossary.ወያነብር: አንበረ — and he sets, places (ወ- + 3ms imperfect, causative a-stem of ነበረ)
glossary.ወያፈልስዎ: አፈለሰ — and they drive him out (ወ- + 3mp imperfect, causative a-stem + -ዎ '3ms him'; impersonal)
glossary.ወይሁብ: ወሀበ — and he gives (ወ- + 3ms imperfect, G, w-h-b)
glossary.ወይሬኢ: ርእየ — and he saw (ወ- + 3ms imperfect, G, used as a narrative past) · and he sees (ወ- + 3ms imperfect, present-habitual: ወይሬኢ ጽልመተ 'and he sees darkness')
glossary.ወይርሕቅ: ርሕቀ — and it goes far (ወ- + 3ms imperfect, G, r-ḥ-q)
glossary.ወይበል: ብህለ — and let him/them say (ወ- + 3ms jussive; defective verb b-h-l; a collective subject takes the singular)
glossary.ወይትመሰው: ተመሰወ — and he melts, dissolves (ወ- + 3ms imperfect, tä-stem)
glossary.ወይትመዐዕ: ተመዐዐ — and he is angry (ወ- + 3ms imperfect, tä-stem)
glossary.ወይትነገፍ: ተነገፈ — and it falls off, is shaken off (ወ- + 3ms imperfect, tä-stem of ነገፈ 'shake')
glossary.ወይከውን: ኮነ — and it will be (ወ- + 3ms imperf., k-w-n)
glossary.ወይየብስ: የብሰ — and it dries up (ወ- + 3ms imperfect, G, y-b-s)
glossary.ወይደመሰስ: ደመሰሰ — and it will be blotted out (ወ- + 3ms imperfect of the quadriliteral ደመሰሰ 'blot out', passive use without tä-)
glossary.ወይዴምር: ደመረ — and he joins, gathers (?) (ወ- + 3ms imperfect, d-m-r; the long ዴ- not explained; sense 'signals' a guess) (?)
glossary.ወይገብእ: ገብአ — and it will return, pass (ወ- + 3ms imperfect, G, g-b-ʾ)
glossary.ወይጠፍእ: ጠፍአ — and it will perish (ወ- + 3ms imperfect, G, ṭ-f-ʾ)
glossary.ውስተ: ውስተ — in, within, into · to, among (ወለአከ ውስተ ኵሉ ነጋድያን 'and he sent to all the merchants') · at (ውስተ መድረከ ኆኃቲሃ 'at the threshold of her doors') · upon, on (ውስተ ሐቌያቲሆሙ 'upon their hips'; ውስተ መንበረ አቡሁ 'on his father's throne')
glossary.ዐማፂ: ዐማፂ — unjust, wrongdoer (agent noun/adjective of ዐመጸ 'act unjustly')
glossary.ዕልው: ዕልው — perverse, crooked (adjective, masc. sg.; from ዐለወ 'be crooked')
glossary.ዘኖመሰ: ኖመ — as for him who slept (ዘ- 'he who' + 3ms perfect, G, n-w-m + contrastive -ሰ 'as for')
glossary.ዘኢኮነ: ኮነ — who was not (ዘ- 'who' + ኢ- 'not' + 3ms perfect G, k-w-n)
glossary.ዘኢየሐዩ: ሐይወ — which does not live (ዘ- relative + ኢ- 'not' + imperfect of ሐይወ 'live'; person and sense uncertain) (?)
glossary.ዘእንበለ: ዘእንበለ — without, except (preposition) · conjunction 'without' + jussive (ዘእንበለ ይስቅይዋ 'without their watering her') · conjunction + perfect 'without (its having been done)' (ዘእንበለ ተሀበኒ ትእምርተ 'without a sign having been given me') · 'except' (ዘእንበለ ዘተሐምም 'except what she suffered') · conjunction 'before' + subjunctive (ዘእንበለ ይስአሉ አበዊነ ንጉሠ 'before our fathers asked for a king') (?) · 'except' before a number (ዘእንበለ ፻ወ፳ ዓመት 'except for a hundred and twenty years') · 'except only' with ዳእሙ (ዘእንበለ ዳእሙ ዘያሠርጽ 'except only what he sows') · 'without' before a noun (ዘእንበለ ኀፍረት 'without shame') · 'except' before a noun (ዘእንበለ ሐሰት 'except falsehood')
glossary.ዘከመዝ: ዘከመዝ — such, thus, in this way (ዘ- + ከመ + ዝ)
glossary.ዘኪያሁ: ኪያሁ — whom, him (ዘ- 'whom' relative + accusative pronoun ኪያ- + -ሁ '3ms him'; resumptive object)
glossary.ዘያመጽእ: አምጽአ — who brings (ዘ- 'who' relative + 3ms imperfect, causative a-stem)
glossary.ዘያፈደፍድ: አፈድፈደ — who increases (ዘ- relative + 3ms imperfect, causative of the quadriliteral ፈድፈደ 'multiply, add much')
glossary.ዘይሴሰይ: ሴሰየ — what one eats (ዘ- 'that which' + 3ms imperfect of the quadriliteral ሴሰየ 'eat, take food') · who eats (ዘይሴሰይ እክልየ 'who eats my food')
glossary.ዘይነሣእ: ነሥአ — who takes (ዘ- relative + 3ms imperfect, G)
glossary.ዘጽሑፍ: ጽሑፍ — what is written (ዘ- relative + passive participle ጽሑፍ)
glossary.የሐውር: ሖረ — he walks, goes (3ms imperfect, ḥ-w-r)
glossary.ያመጽእ: አምጽአ — he brings (3ms imperfect, causative a-stem of መጽአ 'come')
glossary.ያስሕት: አስሕተ — he leads astray (3ms imperfect, causative a-stem of ሳሀተ/ሰሀተ 'err')
glossary.ያአትትዎ: አእተተ — let them remove him (3mp imperfect, here optative, causative a-stem + -ዎ '3ms him'; impersonal plural)
glossary.ይሁዳ: ይሁዳ — Judah (proper name) · Judas, the betrayer (በእንተ ይሁዳ ድልው ሊተ ዐስብየ 'concerning Judas, my wage is ready'; heading of ch. 108)
glossary.ይሬኢ: ርእየ — he sees (3ms imperfect, G, r-ʾ-y)
glossary.ይስረይ: ሠረየ — that he forgive (3ms subjunctive, G, ś-r-y; written with ሰ)
glossary.ይቀጽብ: ቀጸበ — he winks, blinks (3ms imperfect, G, q-ṣ-b; root sense 'blink, strike') (?)
glossary.ይቁም: ቆመ — let him stand (3ms jussive, G, q-w-m)
glossary.ይቅትል: ቀተለ — that he kill (3ms subjunctive, G, q-t-l)
glossary.ይብል: ብህለ — he says (3ms imperfect, G stem, defective verb b-h-l)
glossary.ይትሀጐል: ተሀጕለ — he/it perishes (3ms imperfect, tä-stem of ሀጕለ)
glossary.ይትዔገሎ: ተዐገለ (?) — he besets, surrounds him (?) (3ms imperfect, tä-stem + -ኦ 'him'; exact root uncertain) (?)
glossary.ይትፌሥሕ: ተፈሥሐ — he rejoices (3ms imperfect, tä-stem, f-ś-ḥ)
glossary.ይነብብ: ነበበ — he speaks (3ms imperfect, G, n-b-b)
glossary.ይንሣእ: ነሥአ — that he take (3ms subjunctive, G) · let him take (3ms jussive, ሢመቶሂ ይንሣእ ባዕድ 'let another take his office')
glossary.ይንዕዎ: ነዐወ (?) — they hunt, pursue him (?) (3mp imperfect + -ዎ '3ms him'; person not secure; root not fixed in Dillmann, and ነዐወ is read 'prevail' (?) elsewhere in this text) (?)
glossary.ይወፅእ: ወፅአ — he/it goes out (3ms imperfect, G, w-ṣ-ʾ)
glossary.ይዘርዎ: ዘረወ — they scatter him (3mp imperfect, G, z-r-w + -ዎ '3ms him')
glossary.ይጠፍእ: ጠፍአ — he/it vanishes, perishes (3ms imperfect, G, ṭ-f-ʾ)
glossary.ደቂቀ: ደቂቅ — sons, children (plural ደቂቅ, construct 'sons of')
glossary.ዲቤሁ: ዲበ — upon him, upon it (preposition, stem ዲቤ- + -ሁ '3ms')
glossary.ዳዊት: ዳዊት — David (proper name) · 'ዳዊት' also in ማኅፈደ ዳዊት 'tower (?) of David' (genitive after a construct) · also the young prince Menelik, styled David (እግዚእክሙ ዳዊት 'your lord David')
glossary.ድልው: ድልው — fitting, ready, due (adjective, masc. sg.)
glossary.ድማሑ: ድማሕ (?) — his crown, top of the head (?) (noun + -ሁ '3ms his'; sense and lemma uncertain) (?)
glossary.ግፍቱእ: ግፍቱእ — perverted, oppressed (?) (adjective, masc. sg., passive-participle form; perhaps of ገፍትአ 'thrust, oppress') (?)
glossary.ጥቡዕ: ጥቡዕ — firm, resolute (adjective, masc. sg.; or 'broken'; sense uncertain) (?)
glossary.ጽሉእ: ጽሉእ — hated, abominable (adjective, masc. sg.; passive participle of ጸልአ 'hate')
glossary.ጽድቅ: ጽድቅ — righteousness, justice (noun; ፀሐየ ጽድቅ 'sun of righteousness')
glossary.ፀዋግ: ፀዋግ — wretched, base (adj.); sense uncertain: elsewhere in this text it names a low fellow, and in a Proverbs 6:12 citation a worthless man
glossary.ፍርሀተ: ፍርሀት — fear (construct 'fear of') · also accusative, object: ያአትት ፍርሀተ 'he removes fear'
glossary.ፍትሐ: ፍትሕ — judgment, justice (noun, accusative) · construct 'judgment of' (ፍትሐ ሕዝበ አምላከ እስራኤል 'judgment of the people of the God of Israel')
glossary.ፍናዋተ: ፍኖት — paths, ways (noun, fem., plural ፍናዋት, accusative)
glossary.፻፰: ፻፰ — 108, spoken ምእት ወሰመንቱ (məʾət wä-sämäntu) 'a hundred and eight' (numeral; chapter number)
